name: Fang Bo

honours.event: World Championships, mixed doubles (with Petrissa Solja)

notes: Fang Bo was a member of the Chinese team that won the 2016 World Team Championships, and he reached the men's singles final at the 2015 World Championships, beating Xu Xin and Zhang Jike on the way. He retired from the Chinese national team in 2021.

He returned in 2026 playing for Kazakhstan, in partnership with the Nomad Table Tennis Academy. He kept his Chinese nationality, and under the terms of the switch he does not play the Olympics, World Championships or World Cup.

At WTT Contender Istanbul in November 2026 he entered as a wild card ranked 160th and won the title. He beat Mehdi Bouloussa, Chen Junsong and Lubomir Jancarik, each 3-0, came back from 2-0 down to beat Ricardo Walther 3-2 in the semi-finals, then beat Kang Dongsoo 4-1 in the final. It was his first international singles title since 2013.

In the world ranking of 16 November 2026 he rose 94 places to 66th, back in the top 100, after his Istanbul title. His courtside coach Li Liangfu wrote that Fang played that event with a neck injury, needing treatment and painkillers before every match; Fang pays for his own travel and has no support staff.

He withdrew from the men's singles at WTT Star Contender Muscat in November 2026 before his second qualifying match, a day after winning in Istanbul, giving Eduard Ionescu a walkover; no reason was given.
